# Real MT5 Strategy Tester reports

This directory is intentionally empty of reports.

When a research-only terminal has actually run the generated
`{system}_{year}_real_ticks.ini` jobs, drop the English Strategy Tester
`.htm` files here (UTF-16 is fine). Do not rename them to look synthetic,
and do not place funded-account or Super Signals exports in this tree.

`tests/test_goldthinker_factory_real_mt5_reports.py` is skipped until those
files exist and the skip is removed. Nothing in this slot is executed, and
no broker credential belongs here.
